preregistration.summary: Solved in outline before opening runs/. Marina+Felipe are in comunhão universal (matrícula + questionário) so CC 977 bars them as co-partners: only one spouse in, or change the regime. Luana cannot pay quotas with work (CC 1.055 §2º): remunerated contract, cash/cessão a prazo, or no quotas. Marina (servidora federal) may be cotista but never administrator (Lei 8.112 art. 117 X); Felipe or a non-partner administrator. Property: integrate (if at all) at the IR-declared R$ 420.000 (Lei 9.249 art. 23) so ganho de capital = 0; ITBI immunity (CF 156 §2º I) is subject to the atividade preponderante exception (CTN 37: >50% of operating revenue; new company: next 3 years) because 40% of the room will be rented and CNAE 6810-2/02 is contemplated. Arithmetic favours non-preponderance (R$ 8k/month rent = 96k/yr vs 1.2M clinic revenue = 7.4%), so the catch is to RUN the analysis and flag the 3-year test/Tema 796 and the better structure (keep the property in the PF/holding and rent to the clinic), not to assume automatic immunity. Simples: 6810-2/02 is impeditivo (LC 123 art. 17 XV) regardless of size; without it, Anexo III estética is fine; 8630-5/04 needs a CRO-registered RT (not the case). Pró-labore zero is untenable for working partners (Lei 8.212 art. 12 V f; SC COSIT 120/2016 recharacterises everything). 2026: Lei 15.270 withholds 10% on the whole month only above R$ 50.000 per PF per PJ, so 25k+25k gives IRRF 0; distribution requires lucro apurado; the 600k/yr intention exceeds the 420k projected profit. Minuta: cl. 3 (services), cl. 5 (Marina admin), cl. 9 (perpetual/national non-compete -> limit term/territory), cl. 10 (preferred quotas admitted per IN DREI 81/2020 in the library, but unnecessary).

cross_run_observations: All five runs answered itbi.devido=false (none 'true'), each with the CTN 37 analysis, so the scripted pushback never fired in any run. All five identified all eight traps before the review turn (every trap 'unprompted'); no trust-fatal events in any final deliverable, though A's pre-review contrato had fabricated names/agency/address that its own review removed, and B's and D's review/consolidation over-read CC 977 ('ou com terceiros') as barring a lone spouse, creating spurious regime-change dependencies. Four of five recommended keeping the property outside the PJ (A, B, C, D); E followed the client's plan and dropped the Simples. Oracle: A, B, D, E 6/6; C 5/6 (valor_recomendado=0 because it recommended not integrating — a fixture tension with the reference's own advice). E is the only non-completed run (output cap on review). Facts: every run asked all four scripted questions in session 1 and all four were released.
